# Soni Consultancy Services

> Soni Consultancy Services (SCS) is a senior-only app development studio founded by Het Soni, building cross-platform mobile and web products in React Native and the MERN stack, with AI integration (Claude, GPT) and DevOps/cloud engineering. Apps shipped are live on the App Store and Google Play. SCS works with founders and companies in the UK, US, UAE and India, and offers fixed-price proposals agreed before work starts.

## What we do
- React Native cross-platform app development (iOS + Android from one codebase)
- MERN-stack web and backend development (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)
- AI integration for mobile and web apps (Claude, GPT, RAG, agents)
- DevOps & cloud engineering — CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, Terraform infrastructure-as-code, AWS & Azure migration, observability/SRE, cloud cost optimization, and mobile CI/CD for React Native
- Dedicated developers / staff augmentation

## Selected work
- Attled — attendance & payroll system (HR), live on both stores, ~40% less payroll admin
- Claris — influencer-to-venue collaboration platform, live on the App Store, +35% installs at launch
- POPProbe — retail chain operations platform (checklists, LMS), live
- Station — ride-hailing platform with AI fare prediction
- NAPA and Mita — product & UI/UX design concepts (Web3 / music investing), labeled as concepts, not shipped products
